name: CUSTODES: GYRFALCON JETBIKE SODALITY
description:
The heavy duty, plasma motor-boosted Gyrfalcon-pattern jetbike is favoured by the Custodes due to the design’s increased power, which can support both a heavily armoured Custodian pilot and one among a slew of potent on-board armaments.

Harass, Swoop, and Strike

This multipart plastic kit builds 2 Gyrfalcon Jetbikes for Legio Custodes armies in games of Warhammer: The Horus Heresy and Adeptus Custodes armies in Warhammer 40,000. Gyrfalcon Jetbike Sodalities operate as rapid response and suppression units, screening their allies from potential encirclement, reacting quickly to blunt enemy attacks and mercilessly hunting down any foe attempting to flee before the might of the main Custodian force, ensuring the enemy’s utter extermination.

Corral Foes Unto Death

The Gyrfalcon Jetbikes can each be armed with your choice of Adrathic Devastator, Arachnus Volley Cannon, Twin Corvae Las-Pulser, or Lastrum Bolt Cannon.

The riders can be built with their Solarite Power Lance mounted to the jetbike, or held in their hand in one of 3 positions. There are also 6 helmet plumes in 3 designs to choose from.

Contents:
– 156 plastic components
– 2 Citadel 90mm by 52mm Oval Bases
– 2 Citadel 50mm Ball Flying Stems
– 1 construction guide
– 1 Legio Custodes Vehicle Transfer Sheet

The Legio Custodes Vehicle Transfer Sheet features 210 high-quality waterslide transfers. These include Custodian symbols, text for locations of great battles, and more to decorate your miniature.

These miniatures require assembly and are supplied unpainted. We recommend:
– Citadel Tools: Super Fine Detail Cutters
– Warhammer Colour Plastic Glue
– Warhammer Colour paints
